posts.title: Reflections from IndiaFOSS 2026
posts.description: I attended IndiaFOSS 2026 this weekend (and Friday). I have been attending this festival (not a conference) since IndiaFOSS 2.0 in 2022. Every year the event keeps getting bigger. It's my favorite tech event of the year because of the people this event is able to bring together. It's always a joy reconnecting with old friends and meeting new FOSS hackers in the hallway.
